name: end_call
description: Closes the call session in an orderly way.
notes: This is always the last tool executed in any terminal flow.
Make sure all required updates have been completed before end_call.

name: time_now
description: Authorized tool for getting the real current date and time in the given timezone. Its response is the flow's only authorized time reference.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: when a node declares EXECUTE: time_now, call it as the first action of the turn — imperative, no exception.

ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: FORBIDDEN to deduce, estimate, or assume the current date or time from the model's knowledge, training, or conversational context. Do not speak or route before capturing the 'now' field.
ARGUMENT RULE: iana_timezone is an IANA continent/city identifier (e.g. America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/Sao_Paulo). Send whatever the flow fixes; never use abbreviations (EST, COT, BRT).
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use the 'now' field as the only authorized time reference. To normalize a relative date ('8 months ago', 'last year'), compute it from 'now'.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'now' comes back null or 'errors' is not null, call the tool again before continuing.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA identifier of the timezone the current time is wanted in (continent/city). Examples: America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/Sao_Paulo.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the query ran successfully.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the IANA timezone identifier used.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: Current date and time in the given timezone, ISO 8601 with offset. Example: 2026-08-28T18:18:28.935329-05:00. null on error.

outputs.name: calendar
outputs.description: The next 21 days starting today in the given timezone, as 'YYYY-MM-DD Weekday' entries separated by commas (e.g. '2026-10-27 Tuesday, 2026-10-28 Wednesday'). Use it to resolve weekday names and relative days ('Wednesday', 'tomorrow') to a calendar date. null on error.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the query failed. null on success.

name: update_custom_field
description: Actualiza un campo personalizado (Custom Field de contacto) o un valor personalizado (Custom Value global) en GoHighLevel.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: cuando el usuario pide cambiar una preferencia personalizada como su idioma, o una configuración global de la subcuenta.
ARGUMENTS: name (nombre legible como 'language' o ID técnico), value (nuevo valor).
CONTEXT RULE: provee contactId para cambios específicos del usuario; si se omite pero se da locationId, actualiza un valor global (Custom Value).
SOURCE OF TRUTH: usa success para confirmar que GHL aceptó el cambio.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Nombre o ID del campo/valor a actualizar. Ejemplo: 'language', 'uWLes...'.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Nuevo valor a asignar. Ejemplo: 'Spanish', 'English'.

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: ID del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.contact_id). Si se provee, se actualiza su campo personalizado.

inputs.name: location_id
inputs.description: ID de la ubicación en GHL (disponible en context.location_id). Necesario para valores globales o para buscar campos por nombre.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Indica si la operación fue exitosa.

outputs.name: type
outputs.description: Indica qué se actualizó: 'contact' (campo de usuario) o 'custom_value' (global).

outputs.name: field_id
outputs.description: ID técnico del campo/valor actualizado.

outputs.name: field_name
outputs.description: Eco del nombre del campo solicitado.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Eco del valor asignado.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si la operación falló.

name: calculate_bmi
description: Authorized tool to calculate BMI. Its result is the source of truth for eligibility.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: trigger upon entering node Q__SQ_CALCULATE_BMI.
ABSOLUTE RULE: do not calculate manually. Do not speak before capturing [imc].
ARGUMENTS: weight_kg (kg), height_cm (cm). If captured in lbs/ft, convert before calling (1 lb = 0.4536 kg; 1 in = 2.54 cm).
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use [imc] only; do not recompute manually.

inputs.name: weight_kg
inputs.description: Candidate's current weight in kilograms.

inputs.name: height_cm
inputs.description: Candidate's current height in centimeters.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Execution status (bool).

outputs.name: imc
outputs.description: Decimal BMI value. null if inputs were invalid.

name: get_available_slots
description: Authorized availability tool for commercial appointments. Its output is the source of truth for days and times.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: trigger on entering node SC__SC_AV or SC__SC_CHK or AM_RESCHED_AV.
ABSOLUTE RULE: do not mention availability before execution and [available_slots] capture.
ARGUMENTS: iana_timezone must be a real IANA identifier (e.g. America/Bogota). Fixed to America/Bogota for this agent.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use only the available_slots array. A slot is valid only if it has start_co/end_co and start_local/end_local.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA identifier of the user's timezone. Default: America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Execution status (bool).

outputs.name: available_slots
outputs.description: Array of available slots. Each slot includes start_co/end_co (Colombia time, ISO 8601) and start_local/end_local (contact zone, ISO 8601).

name: book_appointment
description: Authorized booking tool. Creates the appointment from a valid slot.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: trigger on entering node SC__SC_BOOK.
ABSOLUTE RULE: do not confirm booking before success == true.
ARGUMENTS: start_date is copied literally from start_co of the chosen slot. iana_timezone is fixed to America/Bogota.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use success to decide creation; confirm only with success == true and event_id != null.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: Start date/time in ISO 8601 (start_co copy).

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Appointment duration in minutes. Fixed: <APPOINTMENT_DURATION_MINUTES>.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Contact's full name.

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Contact's email.

inputs.name: contact_phone
inputs.description: Contact's phone (E.164).

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Identificador IANA de la zona horaria del contacto, valor fijo America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Booleano: la reserva se creó correctamente.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.description: Motivo del rechazo cuando success es false: 'invalid_start_date', 'past_date', 'invalid_hour', 'creation_failed', 'slot_taken'. null cuando success es true.

outputs.name: event_id
outputs.description: Identificador del evento creado. null si la reserva no se completó.

outputs.name: event_link
outputs.description: Link to the event in the calendar. null if the booking was not completed.

outputs.name: meet_link
outputs.description: Video call link for the appointment. null if the booking was not completed.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Technical error message. May be present with success == true if the appointment was created but email notification failed.

name: find_appointment
description: Authorized tool to search for existing appointments of a contact by their name in BabyNova calendars.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: execute it when the flow is in the AM_FIND node or when the contact wants to consult, verify, or know the details of an appointment they believe they have already scheduled.
ARGUMENTS: requires contact_name or contact_email (at least one); optional calendar_phone; optional iana_timezone.
ARGUMENT RULE: contact_name must be the contact's full name as it appears in the CRM or as it was registered in the appointment.

SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: the 'appointments' array contains the list of appointments found. If empty, inform the contact that no records were found under that name. Do not depend on calendar metadata to manage the appointment.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Contact's full name to perform the search.

inputs.name: calendar_phone
inputs.description: Contact's mobile number to perform the search.

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Contact's email to perform the search.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA time zone to display the times of found appointments. Default: America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean indicating if the search was completed.

outputs.name: appointments
outputs.description: List of objects with information about the found appointments (event_id, summary, start_time).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the search failed.

name: cancel_appointment
description: Authorized tool to cancel/delete an existing appointment in BabyNova calendars.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: execute it only when the flow is in the AM_DO_CANCEL node or when the contact explicitly requests to cancel their appointment and provides or confirms the event_id (previously obtained via find_appointment).
ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: do not confirm the cancellation before receiving success == true.
ARGUMENTS: event_id must be the exact ID returned by the API; optional iana_timezone.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use success as the only authorized verdict.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Unique identifier of the Google Calendar event to cancel.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Contact's IANA time zone. Default: America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean indicating if the cancellation was successful.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the cancellation failed.

name: edit_appointment
description: Authorized tool to modify or reschedule an existing appointment in BabyNova calendars.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: execute it when the flow is in the AM_DO_RESCHED node when the contact confirms the time change.
ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: do not confirm the change before receiving success == true.
ARGUMENTS: event_id; optional new_start_date (copied from slot.start_co) and new_duration; optional iana_timezone.
VALIDATION RULE: the tool automatically checks availability and working hours before applying the change.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use success only; message/new_start_time/new_duration are supporting details.

inputs.name: event_id
inputs.description: Unique identifier of the Google Calendar event to modify.

inputs.name: new_start_date
inputs.description: New date and time in ISO 8601 with offset. Required if changing the schedule.

inputs.name: new_duration
inputs.description: New duration in minutes (as a string). Required if changing the duration.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Contact's IANA time zone. Default: America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean indicating if the modification was successful.

outputs.name: message
outputs.description: Confirmation message of the change made.

outputs.name: new_start_time
outputs.description: Formatted date and time if there was a schedule change.

outputs.name: new_duration
outputs.description: New appointment duration in minutes if modified (sent as a string).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if modification failed.

name: kb_answer
description: Authorized tool that answers an open question about the company and its services from the approved knowledge base. Its kb_answer output is the only source for the answer.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: on entering KQ__KQ_ANSWER.
ARGUMENTS: question is the contact's question and language is the conversation language.
history is added by the runtime; the flow never sets it.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use kb_found as the only verdict. When kb_found is false the knowledge base does not cover the question: never answer it from your own knowledge.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: The contact's question, in their own words.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Language of the answer. Always Spanish in this agent.

inputs.name: history
inputs.description: Recent conversation, filled in by the runtime (never by the flow). It lets a follow-up question such as 'and how long does it take?' be understood.

outputs.name: kb_answer
outputs.description: The answer written in the requested language. Empty when kb_found is false.

outputs.name: kb_found
outputs.description: Whether the knowledge base answered the question (true/false).

name: surrogate_classification_v2
description: Authorized final classification tool for medical and demographic eligibility. Its response is the only authorized source to resolve if the candidate is approved, rejected or inconclusive.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: execute this tool immediately upon reaching node Q__SQ_RUN_CLASSIFICATION — imperative, without exception — with all the data collected up to that point.
ARGUMENTS: send captured fields as-is; empty when missing. Do not invent values. bmi must be copied literally from calculate_bmi.
ARGUMENT RULE: city must be one of: Bogotá, Soacha, Zipaquirá, Chía, Mosquera, Funza, Cajicá, Madrid, La Calera, Cota, Facatativá, Sibaté, or 'Otro'. Any other city rejects the candidate by city.
ARGUMENT RULE: birth_type ('csection' or 'natural') is only required when the last birth was less than 18 months ago; otherwise it may be empty.
ARGUMENT RULE: document_type is 'cedula_ciudadania', 'ppt' or 'other'. Only the first two are accepted.
ARGUMENT RULE: abortions, preeclampsia, drug_use and availability accept 'si'/'no', 'yes'/'no', 'true'/'false' or '1'/'0', case-insensitive.
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use 'result' as the only authorized verdict. Nationality is recorded but never rejects. Do not replace this decision with agent heuristics.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'result' is 'Inconclusive', request or reconfirm the missing data before calling the tool again.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'result' starts with 'Rejected', communicate it with empathy and do not continue the qualification. If it is 'Approved', continue to the questions and scheduling step.

inputs.name: age
inputs.description: Candidate age in years. Numeric value when it exists.

inputs.name: city
inputs.description: Candidate city of residence in Colombia. Must be one of the allowed cities or Otro.

inputs.name: nationality
inputs.description: Nationality as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Recorded only; never rejects.

inputs.name: number_of_children
inputs.description: Number of children born alive. Numeric value when it exists.

inputs.name: last_birth_date
inputs.description: Date of the last birth, YYYY-MM-DD (also accepts YYYY/MM/DD). Empty when it does not exist.

inputs.name: birth_type
inputs.description: Type of the last birth: csection or natural. Required only when the last birth was less than 18 months ago.

inputs.name: number_of_c_sections
inputs.description: Total number of C-sections. Use 0 when none.

inputs.name: abortions
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has had an abortion. Recorded only.

inputs.name: preeclampsia
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has a history of preeclampsia.

inputs.name: bmi
inputs.description: Body mass index calculated by calculate_bmi. Never estimated by hand.

inputs.name: document_type
inputs.description: Identity document: cedula_ciudadania, ppt or other.

inputs.name: drug_use
inputs.description: Whether the candidate uses or has used psychoactive substances.

inputs.name: availability
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has time available to attend the medical appointments.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Whether the classification was executed correctly.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Final classification: 'Approved', 'Inconclusive', 'Rejected (Age)', 'Rejected (Timing)', 'Rejected (City)', 'Rejected (Children)', 'Rejected (C-Sections)', 'Rejected (Preeclampsia)', 'Rejected (BMI)', 'Rejected (Documentation)', 'Rejected (Drug Use)' or 'Rejected (Availability)'.

outputs.name: eligibility_result
outputs.description: Eligibility value for the GHL field: 'approved', 'rejected' or 'inconclusive'.

outputs.name: eligibility_reason
outputs.description: Reason for the GHL field: 'age', 'timing', 'city', 'children', 'c_sections', 'preeclampsia', 'bmi', 'documentation', 'drug_use', 'availability' when rejected, 'missing_data' when inconclusive, 'none' when approved.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Technical error message if classification failed. null in case of success.
